# clickup_space (Resource)

## Schema

### Required

- `features` (Attributes) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--features))
- `multiple_assignees` (Boolean)

### Optional

- `admin_can_manage` (Boolean) ***Note:** Allowing or restricting admins from managing private Spaces using `"admin_can_manage"` is an [Enterprise Plan](https://clickup.com/pricing) feature.*
